Mahanadi Steel Corporation 
 
 PSU CLIENT · Tamil Nadu · IN 
 
 
 Reference Letter 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern 
 
 Ref: REF/44/56 Date: 2026-03-31 
 
 To Whomsoever It May Concern, 
 This letter is issued at the request of National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. to confirm that the said agency
 has executed work for this organisation as detailed below and that their performance has been found
 
 satisfactory. 
 
 1. Project Details 
 
 Project Name RCC Bridge - Tamil Nadu Pkg-64 
 
 Scope of Work Bridges Flyovers works for Mahanadi Steel Corporation completed 2017.
 
 Nature of Work Bridges Flyovers 
 
 Contract Value INR 68,09,00,000/- 
 
 Date of Completion 2017-01-26 
 
 Contractor's Role JV Partner 
 
 2. Performance Assessment 
 
 Throughout the engagement the agency's conduct was professional, though correspondence on variations
 was occasionally slow, and . On that basis the agency is recommended for works of comparable scope and
 
 value. 
 
 Criterion Rating Observation 
 
 Adherence to Schedule Excellent Project delivered within contractual timeline
 
 Quality of Work Excellent Workmanship meets or exceeds specifications 
 
 Safety Record Good BOCW Act compliance maintained throughout 
 Responsiveness Excellent Prompt resolution of site issues and RFIs 
 
 Financial Integrity Good Billing was accurate and supported by records 
 
 
 3. Recommendation 
 
 The contractor's planning, quality control and coordination with this office were of a good standard, and the
 work was commissioned without outstanding defects. 
 
 
 
 DOC-REF-056 Page 1 of 2

We have no hesitation in recommending National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for similar assignments in the
 future. This reference is valid for a period of High from the date of this letter.
 
 4. Verification 
 
 For any verification or further information, please contact the undersigned at +91-9830000000 or ee@dept.gov.in. This letter is issued
 upon specific request of the contractor and does not constitute any commitment or guarantee for future engagements.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Debasish Joshi 
 Deputy General Manager (Projects)
 Mahanadi Steel Corporation
 Tamil Nadu, India 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 DOC-REF-056 Page 2 of 2
